QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Amnesiac Temple Keeper Kao
QuestInfo.0: The Amnesiac Temple Keeper that the Memory Keeper talked about came here and did something wrong. Ask what happened.
QuestInfo.1: The Temple Keeper, Kao, is looking for clues to help find their lost memories. They feel a strong connection to this place, something that could jog their memory. But while investigating the town, they discover something strange... What is going on?
QuestInfo.2: The people of the Nameless Town place their memories upon the Tree of Memories, so that they can gaze upon them every day. The Temple Keeper Kao investigated this tree in hopes of recovering their lost memories. But upon touching the tree, the memories it held scattered! Without their memories, the townspeople are heartbroken, and the boat across the  Lake of Oblivion has stopped running. There is no other way forward.

0.msg: The resentment of the townspeople... Their cold attitude... The quiet town... It wasn't like that in the beginning.

1.msg: They were delicate beings that lived at peace with their few remaining memories...\r\n\r\n

2.msg: It's all my fault. I ruined everything.

3.msg: #b(He looks very confused. You should ask him what's going on.)#k

yes.0: There's something I have to warn you about. Have you seen the large lake at the outskirts of town? The townspeople call it the Lake of Oblivion. If you fall in, you'll forget everything. Every last memory.
yes.1: Maybe it's due to living so close to the lake, but the people around here have been gradually losing their memory every day. That's why this Tree of Memory was created. Precious memories are hung on this tree. The townspeople can come by to look at them every day until the memories wither and vanish...
yes.2: When I heard about the tree from the townspeople, my heart started racing. I thought there might be memories related to me there, so I came to investigate. But...
yes.3: I still don't know why. The moment I touched the tree...
yes.4: All those memories... The precious memories of the townspeople... They all scattered. Everyone was heartbroken. Their daily routines came to a halt. Even the boat that sails across Lake of Oblivion stopped running.
